entry.title: Van Thuy Hoang won the Excellence Award in the 23rd Graduate School Academic Awards

link.title: Van Thuy Hoang won the Excellence Award in the 23rd Graduate School Academic Awards

entry.summary: Van Thuy Hoang, who recently earned his doctoral degree from the Network Science Lab @ CUK, received the Excellence Award (우수상) at the 23rd Graduate School Academic Awards (제23회 대학원 학술상) Ceremony for his outstanding research in graph learning, following his Best Award (최우수상) at the 22nd awards last year.

entry.title: CaMol, A Novel Causality Inference Framework for Few-shot Molecular Property Prediction

link.title: CaMol, A Novel Causality Inference Framework for Few-shot Molecular Property Prediction

entry.summary: The Network Science Lab at the Catholic University of Korea releases a Causality Inference Framework, namely CaMol, a novel causality inference framework for few-shot molecular property prediction.

entry.title: MVCIB, A Novel Pre-trained Graph Neural Network Model on 2D and 3D Molecular Structures

link.title: MVCIB, A Novel Pre-trained Graph Neural Network Model on 2D and 3D Molecular Structures

entry.summary: The Network Science Lab at the Catholic University of Korea releases Multi-View Conditional Information Bottleneck, namely MVCIB, a novel pre-trained Graph Neural Network model specialised in 2D and 3D Molecular Structures.

entry.title: Major of AI-Chemical Engineering Launched
entry.summary: We are pleased to announce the establishment of a new Major of AI-Chemical Engineering in the Department of Artificial Intelligence at the Graduate School, in addition to the existing Major of Artificial Intelligence.

entry.title: One NS-CUK paper accepted for IEEE TNSE

link.title: One NS-CUK paper accepted for IEEE TNSE

entry.summary: Members of the Network Science Lab at the Catholic University of Korea submitted one paper on mitigating the degree bias problem in the message passing mechanism to the IEEE TNSE (Transactions on Network Science and Engineering) and was accepted.

entry.title: Van Thuy Hoang won the Best Award in the 22nd Graduate School Academic Awards

link.title: Van Thuy Hoang won the Best Award in the 22nd Graduate School Academic Awards

entry.summary: Van Thuy Hoang, a doctoral student at the Network Science Lab @ CUK, received the Best Award (최우수상) at the 22nd Graduate School Academic Awards (제22회 대학원 학술상) Ceremony for his outstanding research in graph learning, highlighting the lab's leadership in graph ML.

entry.title: One NS-CUK paper presented at AAAI’25

link.title: One NS-CUK paper presented at AAAI’25

entry.summary: Members of the Network Science Lab at the Catholic University of Korea presented a paper on pre-training molecular graph neural networks at the 39th AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2025).

entry.title: Halal or Not, A Novel GNN Model for Predicting Cultural Appropriateness of Everyday Products

link.title: Halal or Not, A Novel GNN Model for Predicting Cultural Appropriateness of Everyday Products

entry.summary: The Network Science Lab at the Catholic University of Korea releases Halal or Not (HaCKG), a novel attributed knowledge graph completion model for predicting cultural appropriateness of everyday products (mainly, halal and haram of cosmetics).

entry.title: S-CGIB, A Novel Pre-trained Graph Neural Network Model in Molecular Structure Learning

link.title: S-CGIB, A Novel Pre-trained Graph Neural Network Model in Molecular Structure Learning

entry.summary: The Network Science Lab at the Catholic University of Korea releases S-CGIB, a novel pre-trained graph neural network model for molecular structure learning.

entry.title: One NS-CUK paper accepted for AAAI’25

link.title: One NS-CUK paper accepted for AAAI’25

entry.summary: Members of the Network Science Lab at the Catholic University of Korea submitted one paper on pre-training graph neural networks on molecules to the 39th AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2025) and was accepted.
